build_baseline: run #1 = 9f2cd08 (30 min, birth_max 50.0): A -1035.56 RUB, B -672.77 RUB. This build is fix #7: birth_max 34.5 + diagnostics
entry_fill_price: the first on-chain curve read after detection (the same getMultipleAccounts context that passed the security filters). The WSS packet price is never used for a fill; entry_lag_ms records how old the read was and entry_premium_pct compares the entry mid with the coin t0 mid of that read
run4_arm_a: Round 6 reference, not a single number changed: SL -10% before TP1/rocket, TP1 +30% sells 50%, rocket bypass +50%, trail 0.85x after +10%, shelf 4.5 s, no-progress 5 s, timeouts 35/90 s
run4_arm_b: exit rule only: 100% at market at t >= 15.0 s (time_exit_15s), SL -20% for the whole life of the position, +100% sells 50%, TP1 +30% / trail / shelf / no-progress disabled
run4_why: counterfactual on the same 84 trades: holding to 15 s without SL/TP/trail gives -265 RUB instead of -1344 RUB, i.e. +12.8 RUB/trade. The contribution comes from the take-profits, not the stops: SL/trail group +674 RUB of underperformance (13 trades), SL +175 RUB (21), no-progress -81 RUB (44). Horizon is sharp: 5 s -4.9 RUB, 15 s -3.2 RUB, 60 s -32.6 RUB, 120 s -46.7 RUB
run4_expectation: B -8..-4 RUB/trade against -15..-17 RUB for A. B is still EXPECTED TO LOSE MONEY; the run measures how much of the loss the exit rules cost. No result here means "became profitable"
run4_decision_rule: B beats A iff mean(B) - mean(A) >= +8 RUB and the 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0 (20 000 resamples); shadow_no_trail beats A iff >= +6 RUB with a CI excluding 0; several comparisons -> exploratory, Bonferroni alpha 0.0125
run4_p0_accepted: early_stop_reason = null, unrecovered RPC failures <= 2 % of requests, dropped_events = 0, write_errors = 0, requests_per_sec <= 1.8
run4_p0_instrument: P0-1 ticks carry trigger_pct / fill_pct / exit_latency_ms / peak_pct / peak_t_sec; P0-2 security-rejected coins are read only at offsets 0 and 15 (skipped_security_deep elsewhere) and security_fail_rockets answers the unmeasured blind spot; P0-3 429 retries with Retry-After and 0.2/0.5/1.2 s + jitter, semaphore of 6, shadows polled at 0.5 Hz with one position each; P0-5 artefacts every 60 s and again in the stop handler
fix_7: v_sol_birth_max 50.0 -> 34.5. Measured on run #1: v_sol_birth = 29.96 + dev_buy_SOL (corr 0.99988, n=145), so the old ceiling admitted dev buys of 4-6 SOL; 36 of 50 such candidates fell <= -25% (median minimum -33.2%), and in the live run they were 4 mints for -538.57 RUB in A and -552.79 RUB in B. Expected 22-26 entries instead of 26 and A near -500 RUB: this cuts the catastrophic tail, it does NOT create profit.
timeouts_35_90: slot safety net, not part of 4-mode ladder
known_hole: no_progress is one-shot at 5s; corridor -9.9%..+1.4% exits only by timeout
known_gap: repeat_deploy indexed by program_creator only; event_actor path is log-only this run (creator_prior_tokens_10m_actor)
edge_status: no proven edge; cap 2.5 chosen for drawdown/slot hygiene (archive: delta >= 2.5 -> median -19.8% drawdown, 11 of 13 observed stop-outs). It cuts 3 rockets, not 2: TzXn6LeT +106.8%, E8q82QfE +38.3%, and 6m3gx2eaH +26.8% — the last one from the delta == 0 bucket, so it is cut by delta_min 0.10, not by the cap
judgement: archive: 2.5-4 median max +6.7% (0 rockets); 4-12 bimodal: 9 dead / 2 rockets (+38.3%, +106.8%)
delta_min_note: delta == 0 bucket: 26 of 27 observed dead, not 27 of 27; the single exception is 6m3gx2eaH +26.8%
experiment_next: discriminator inside 4-12 bucket: initialBuy, 5s v_sol velocity, unique buyers. Run #1 added the missing half: the entry price is always worse than observations t0, and the 0.1-2.5 band has a median move of 0.0% with an asymmetric ladder, so zero movement becomes -6..-8% per trade. No threshold fixes that
expected_flow: run #1 measured 236 entry_state per 30 min; cap 2.5 admitted 29 (12.3%), cap 4 would admit 43, cap 12 -> 103. With birth_max 34.5 expect 22-26 A entries and 3-6 B entries per 30 min. admitted_by_current_cap in the manifest answers this from data
open_question_cap: delta cap 2.5 is an anti-selector: in the bought 0.1-2.5 band there was 1 rocket in 33 candidates (3%) and 0 rugs, while 4-12 held 9 rockets in 42 (21%) AND 25 rugs. Delta selects volatility, not quality. Changing the cap is fix #8, deliberately not mixed with #7
entry: 30.5 <= v_sol_birth <= 34.5 and 0.10 <= (v_sol_now - v_sol_birth) <= 2.5  (identical for A and B)
entry_note: run #4 moves the EXIT, not the entry. Both live arms enter on the same rule and the same curve read; only the exit rule differs, so any difference in PnL per trade is the exit rule. The t0 entry (delta_min = 0) is deliberately deferred to the next run: it would change both the entry premium and the flow, and mixing it with the exit change would make the result unattributable.
run3_single_difference: delta_max_sol (closed by run #3: -4.76 RUB, CI [-35.04, 24.44] — criterion not met)
run3_decision_rule: B beats A iff mean(B) - mean(A) >= +10 RUB and the 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0 (20 000 resamples)
run3_why: at 8 h the resolvable difference is +/-12 RUB per trade at n=200 and +/-10 at n=400. The 100%-at-first-tick-+25% exit is worth about +1.5 RUB/trade, so it is unobservable and stays a shadow; the delta band is worth about 29 RUB/trade, so it is the A/B arm. Band EV per trade: 0.1-2.5 = -20, 2.5-4 = +9, 4-12 = -7, 0.1-0.6 = -6, 0.6-1.5 = -33, 1.5-2.5 = -28
bank_rule: каждый профиль ведёт свой кэш; если перед входом cash < 500 ₽, книга пополняется до 1500 ₽ и сделка открывается. Ставка 500 ₽, 3 слота и все входы/выходы не меняются — пополнение влияет только на «торговать / не торговать». Счётчик top_ups остаётся метрикой: пополнение срабатывает лишь при cash < 500, а не после каждого убытка
stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. Порог 2% поднимать запрещено (в run5 подняли до 5% — это 99 несостоявшихся чтений цены). PnL не является причиной остановки

ab_test.expected_sign: negative for both arms; B less negative

portfolio_a.rocket_bypass: at pnl_pct >= +50.0 before TP1: retain 100%, set bypass, do not sell half

portfolio_a.peak_timestamp_update: update only when pnl_pct >= best_pnl_pct + 0.4 percentage points

shadow_gate.build_baseline: run #1 = 9f2cd08 (30 min, birth_max 50.0): A -1035.56 RUB, B -672.77 RUB. This build is fix #7: birth_max 34.5 + diagnostics
shadow_gate.entry_fill_price: the first on-chain curve read after detection (the same getMultipleAccounts context that passed the security filters). The WSS packet price is never used for a fill; entry_lag_ms records how old the read was and entry_premium_pct compares the entry mid with the coin t0 mid of that read
shadow_gate.run4_arm_a: Round 6 reference, not a single number changed: SL -10% before TP1/rocket, TP1 +30% sells 50%, rocket bypass +50%, trail 0.85x after +10%, shelf 4.5 s, no-progress 5 s, timeouts 35/90 s
shadow_gate.run4_arm_b: exit rule only: 100% at market at t >= 15.0 s (time_exit_15s), SL -20% for the whole life of the position, +100% sells 50%, TP1 +30% / trail / shelf / no-progress disabled
shadow_gate.run4_why: counterfactual on the same 84 trades: holding to 15 s without SL/TP/trail gives -265 RUB instead of -1344 RUB, i.e. +12.8 RUB/trade. The contribution comes from the take-profits, not the stops: SL/trail group +674 RUB of underperformance (13 trades), SL +175 RUB (21), no-progress -81 RUB (44). Horizon is sharp: 5 s -4.9 RUB, 15 s -3.2 RUB, 60 s -32.6 RUB, 120 s -46.7 RUB
shadow_gate.run4_expectation: B -8..-4 RUB/trade against -15..-17 RUB for A. B is still EXPECTED TO LOSE MONEY; the run measures how much of the loss the exit rules cost. No result here means "became profitable"
shadow_gate.run4_decision_rule: B beats A iff mean(B) - mean(A) >= +8 RUB and the 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0 (20 000 resamples); shadow_no_trail beats A iff >= +6 RUB with a CI excluding 0; several comparisons -> exploratory, Bonferroni alpha 0.0125
shadow_gate.run4_p0_accepted: early_stop_reason = null, unrecovered RPC failures <= 2 % of requests, dropped_events = 0, write_errors = 0, requests_per_sec <= 1.8
shadow_gate.run4_p0_instrument: P0-1 ticks carry trigger_pct / fill_pct / exit_latency_ms / peak_pct / peak_t_sec; P0-2 security-rejected coins are read only at offsets 0 and 15 (skipped_security_deep elsewhere) and security_fail_rockets answers the unmeasured blind spot; P0-3 429 retries with Retry-After and 0.2/0.5/1.2 s + jitter, semaphore of 6, shadows polled at 0.5 Hz with one position each; P0-5 artefacts every 60 s and again in the stop handler
shadow_gate.fix_7: v_sol_birth_max 50.0 -> 34.5. Measured on run #1: v_sol_birth = 29.96 + dev_buy_SOL (corr 0.99988, n=145), so the old ceiling admitted dev buys of 4-6 SOL; 36 of 50 such candidates fell <= -25% (median minimum -33.2%), and in the live run they were 4 mints for -538.57 RUB in A and -552.79 RUB in B. Expected 22-26 entries instead of 26 and A near -500 RUB: this cuts the catastrophic tail, it does NOT create profit.
shadow_gate.timeouts_35_90: slot safety net, not part of 4-mode ladder
shadow_gate.known_hole: no_progress is one-shot at 5s; corridor -9.9%..+1.4% exits only by timeout
shadow_gate.known_gap: repeat_deploy indexed by program_creator only; event_actor path is log-only this run (creator_prior_tokens_10m_actor)
shadow_gate.edge_status: no proven edge; cap 2.5 chosen for drawdown/slot hygiene (archive: delta >= 2.5 -> median -19.8% drawdown, 11 of 13 observed stop-outs). It cuts 3 rockets, not 2: TzXn6LeT +106.8%, E8q82QfE +38.3%, and 6m3gx2eaH +26.8% — the last one from the delta == 0 bucket, so it is cut by delta_min 0.10, not by the cap
shadow_gate.judgement: archive: 2.5-4 median max +6.7% (0 rockets); 4-12 bimodal: 9 dead / 2 rockets (+38.3%, +106.8%)
shadow_gate.delta_min_note: delta == 0 bucket: 26 of 27 observed dead, not 27 of 27; the single exception is 6m3gx2eaH +26.8%
shadow_gate.experiment_next: discriminator inside 4-12 bucket: initialBuy, 5s v_sol velocity, unique buyers. Run #1 added the missing half: the entry price is always worse than observations t0, and the 0.1-2.5 band has a median move of 0.0% with an asymmetric ladder, so zero movement becomes -6..-8% per trade. No threshold fixes that
shadow_gate.expected_flow: run #1 measured 236 entry_state per 30 min; cap 2.5 admitted 29 (12.3%), cap 4 would admit 43, cap 12 -> 103. With birth_max 34.5 expect 22-26 A entries and 3-6 B entries per 30 min. admitted_by_current_cap in the manifest answers this from data
shadow_gate.open_question_cap: delta cap 2.5 is an anti-selector: in the bought 0.1-2.5 band there was 1 rocket in 33 candidates (3%) and 0 rugs, while 4-12 held 9 rockets in 42 (21%) AND 25 rugs. Delta selects volatility, not quality. Changing the cap is fix #8, deliberately not mixed with #7
shadow_gate.entry: 30.5 <= v_sol_birth <= 34.5 and 0.10 <= (v_sol_now - v_sol_birth) <= 2.5  (identical for A and B)
shadow_gate.run3_single_difference: delta_max_sol (closed by run #3: -4.76 RUB, CI [-35.04, 24.44] — criterion not met)
shadow_gate.run3_decision_rule: B beats A iff mean(B) - mean(A) >= +10 RUB and the 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0 (20 000 resamples)
shadow_gate.run3_why: at 8 h the resolvable difference is +/-12 RUB per trade at n=200 and +/-10 at n=400. The 100%-at-first-tick-+25% exit is worth about +1.5 RUB/trade, so it is unobservable and stays a shadow; the delta band is worth about 29 RUB/trade, so it is the A/B arm. Band EV per trade: 0.1-2.5 = -20, 2.5-4 = +9, 4-12 = -7, 0.1-0.6 = -6, 0.6-1.5 = -33, 1.5-2.5 = -28
shadow_gate.bank_rule: каждый профиль ведёт свой кэш; если перед входом cash < 500 ₽, книга пополняется до 1500 ₽ и сделка открывается. Ставка 500 ₽, 3 слота и все входы/выходы не меняются — пополнение влияет только на «торговать / не торговать». Счётчик top_ups остаётся метрикой: пополнение срабатывает лишь при cash < 500, а не после каждого убытка
shadow_gate.stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. Порог 2% поднимать запрещено (в run5 подняли до 5% — это 99 несостоявшихся чтений цены). PnL не является причиной остановки
shadow_gate.creator_gate: signature_count_0_25 >= 25 AND NOT burst (25+ sigs inside 1h) AND NOT repeat_deploy (>=2 tokens in 10m) AND ata_exists AND token_balance_raw > 0

shadow_exit25.entry_note: run #4 moves the EXIT, not the entry. Both live arms enter on the same rule and the same curve read; only the exit rule differs, so any difference in PnL per trade is the exit rule. The t0 entry (delta_min = 0) is deliberately deferred to the next run: it would change both the entry premium and the flow, and mixing it with the exit change would make the result unattributable.
shadow_exit25.stop_loss: before TP1/rocket bypass only, while best_pnl_pct < +10.0: pnl_pct <= -10.0; sell 100%
shadow_exit25.tp1: when +30.0 <= pnl_pct < +50.0 before TP1/rocket bypass: sell 50%; retry same partial if exact-size quote is unavailable
shadow_exit25.rocket_bypass: at pnl_pct >= +50.0 before TP1: retain 100%, set bypass, do not sell half
shadow_exit25.trailing: once best_pnl_pct >= +10.0: sell remaining at pnl_pct <= 0.85 * best_pnl_pct (labelled SL/trail, not a take-profit)
shadow_exit25.shelf_stagnation: sell remaining when pnl_pct >= +1.5 and no >=+0.4pp new high for 4.5s
shadow_exit25.no_progress: once at held >= 5s: best_pnl_pct < +4.0 and pnl_pct < +1.5; evaluate once
shadow_exit25.peak_timestamp_update: update only when pnl_pct >= best_pnl_pct + 0.4 percentage points

rpc.latency_policy: measure actual latency/errors; no SLA or coverage promise

fees.source: on-chain Pump Global + FeeConfig; quote fills use SDK integer math
fees.on_chain_curve_fees: included in out_amount_raw; reported separately from network fees

filters.shadow_gate_creator_gate: signature_count_0_25 == 25 AND derived ATA exists AND ATA token balance > 0
filters.creator_probe_failures: fail closed for shadow_gate; never gate A or B

observation_policy: scheduled real Pump curve RPC reads; no interpolation or DexScreener/GeckoTerminal fallback for Pump.fun

accounting.gross_curve_pnl_rub: realized snapshot PnL before modeled network fees; on-chain curve fee remains embedded in quote output
accounting.network_fees: tracked separately; deducted from realized returns and shown as open fee liability
